verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents its own alerting: alerts on log patterns, counts and attribute values, alerts seeded from any dashboard panel, and timely notifications on monitored signals delivered through managed notification channels. However, the evidence never shows routing, grouping, or silencing of notifications, and alerting on traces and metrics is only implied through panel-seeded alerts. missing for 10: documented notification routing rules, alert grouping, silencing/muting of notifications, explicit trace- and metric-based alert docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: Set up alerts on log patterns, counts, or attribute values.
create an alert seeded from the panel
Monitor signals and receive timely notifications
manage dashboards, alert rules, saved views, and notification channels.
